description: Get one China Footnotes "Before you go" topic by id: the essentials, a checklist, dated items such as holiday crowd calendars or rule changes, traveler tips and sources. Topic ids come from list_pretrip_topics. Optional sections return selected structured content with sources; without sections the full article is returned. Rules such as visa policy change, so each item carries the date it was checked.

id.description: Topic id from list_pretrip_topics, e.g. "visa" or "payments".

sections.description: Parts of the topic to return; omit for the full article. items: dated items such as rule changes; calendar: holiday crowd calendar.

name: get_pretrip_topic

sources.description: Source id index. Dates are stored evidence dates, not rendering dates; null means unavailable.

title: Get pre-trip topic
